$comment: Hand-authored web deltas for the design system's 17 type styles. Sizes and line heights come from tokens.json. Sizes are emitted as calc(<px> * var(--fathom-type-unit)); the unit is 1/16 rem at the root, so site text follows the browser's text size, and 1px inside the pxScopes, so phone mockups stay pixel-true under zoom. Log any change back to the design system.

tracking.$comment: DS letter-spacing in px scales with the type unit (calc(<px> * unit)); em values pass through. Styles with no DS letter-spacing get the default. Add a per-style override only after a measured difference against an SF render of more than 3% in line width.

family.$comment: The web layer does not paint with the DS families (SF Pro and SF Mono are Apple-only; --fathom-type-<style>-family keeps the DS value for reference). The --text-* styles in app/globals.css set no family and inherit the site's body face. text-mono and text-mono-sm set font-family: var(--font-mono), the site's mono face (Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono once P2 wires it), because the family is what makes them mono. test/ds-tokens.test.ts checks that pairing.

eyebrow.$comment: Uppercase on screen, sentence case in source.

mono.$comment: Counters and distances line up: 2 of 5, about 7 to 10 feet.
